scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap add android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.build:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug && cd .. && powershell -Command "Copy-Item android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk -Destination ArrowEscape.apk -Force"
